meta.title: Charles Hsu — Physical AI & beautiful interfaces
meta.description: Charles Hsu — Physical AI researcher, interface maker, and open-source builder.

hero.title: I make things{br}that {move}.
hero.lede: I study intelligent systems in the physical world. I also make beautiful interfaces and open-source software because the tools we use should feel as considered as the ideas behind them.

now.title: Curious about the gap between {thinking} and {touching}.
now.p1: I am a PhD student researching Physical AI — systems that perceive, reason, and act in the real world. My work lives somewhere between robotics, learning, simulation, and the messy details of making an idea actually run.
now.p2: When I am away from the lab, I design interfaces, maintain open-source tools, and obsess over the little moments that make software feel calm, clear, and surprisingly nice to use.
